title: i saw these two in my mall world last night???
content: so i was at the mall last night and i remember seeing these two... easter is this coming sunday so it made sense. i thought it was weird that the easter bunny had a female counterpart with him but didn't think much of it. now i was just scrolling on fb and this popped up on my feed from a disney world group that i've never interacted with or shown in interest in, i didn't even know these two existed 🥴 now this is especially baffling to me because not only did i see them in my dream... i also saw goofy. mascot style, just like them, just like you'd see at disney. he was sitting on a bench, i remember him waving at me 😭 i know this is hyper-specific and i don't know what to expect by posting it here, i just needed to share because i'm a little weirded out.
